notes.title: Physics, Difficulty, and Changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Anderson here with V1.2.0!

Since Puttler was made, I've been in the pursuit of making the physics 100% fully deterministic. There have been rare issues and marginal errors that would occur with more pieces in play, causing inconsistencies without making any changes to your solutions. On release, this margin of error was less than 99.9%, and with the previous update, we have been able to increase this to nearly 99.99% accuracy. As of today, I'm excited to announce that we MIGHT have finally reached 100% accuracy in the physics, regardless of how many pieces are used. Why do I say might? Well, external factors such as older systems, lagging or stuttering, or other PC-related issues might still cause this to happen, but as far as we've tested, we have yet to experience any inconsistencies with the changes made in this update. If you run into this issue after this patch, please report it to us immediately.

With this being said, now that the physics are in a very healthy place, this means we can start looking into allowing players to save their solutions. If we had done this first before ensuring the physics were 100% deterministic, any tiny changes would have caused everyone's solutions to stop working completely.

When it comes to the difficulty, we wanted to make things easier for casual players to win the course payouts. While we want the core gameplay to be about trying to lower your strokes to get the payout, we've had a few players mention that they are unable to win courses and earn money because the leaderboard strokes are too low. We also noticed a big jump in how many players unlocked beginner course achievements vs. the more difficult ones, and plan to bridge that gap. NPC strokes on the course leaderboards for the campaign have been adjusted, making it easier to earn cash and progress without getting stuck.

Here's a list of all the changes below:

- Major physics improvements to the consistency and simulation, possibly 100% fully deterministic now. (Fingers crossed)
- Leaderboard NPC strokes lowered to make earning the course payouts easier for casual players.
- Slow time feature has been added, so you can now slow down your awesome shots to see every detail!
- Added slow time keybind with default "Shift" key to controls in settings and is fully customizable.
- Ability to reset all keybinds back to default in the controls, with a confirmation window as well.
- Puttler outlines when lifted are no longer solid black, and are now see-through like a shadow, making the contrast less off-putting for some players.
- Added "Move Puttler" default arrow key inputs to controls, so players know they exist. Lol
- Adjusted double-tap snapping angle speed from 0.2s to 0.16s, to help prevent players from accidentally rotating 90 degrees unless intended.
- Changed word to close game from "Exit" to "Quit" in the settings, to be more clear for players and standardized with other games.
- Changed game version format to semantic (people don't like when we use big numbers).

Join our Discord!

notes.title: V1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Anderson here! 

We've been listening closely to your suggestions and feedback, whether you mentioned it through Discord, email, or in the reviews, we appreciate your input and you've been heard. We've improved the physics, added several quality of life features, made visual improvements, and other various changes to increase the overall player experience. Here's a list of all the changes made in the update below:

Physics:
- Adjusted physics for increased simulation accuracy.
- The golf ball now bounces off walls while moving at lower speeds instead of getting stuck to the wall. If the golf ball is moving very slowly however, it will not bounce.
- Golf ball physics adjusted to have a more gradual bounce decrease into the rolling state. 

Quality of Life:
- Directional buttons can now be used to move puttlers by 0.01 units in all directions. These keybinds are hardcoded and non-customizable. Now for the love of god please stop asking me for this feature.💀
- Left mouse button can now be used to drop puttlers. Right mouse button can still be used as well.
- Mouse scroll wheel can now be used to rotate puttlers both directions.
- Double tapping the rotation button quickly now instantly snaps puttlers to 90, 180, 270, and 360 degrees.
- Puttlers now use a micro grid system, snapping every 0.01 units. This is to make previous solutions more replicable, removing unnecessary decimal points not visible to the eye.
- When a payout is owed and the player leaves to the world, they will be sent home instead to claim their prize. This is to prevent any confusion and ensure the player gets instantly rewarded.

Visuals:
- Puttlers are now highlighted with a black background outline when lifted to make them more visible when moveable. 
- Puttlers are now darker when unplaceable for better visibility overlapping other objects.
- Golf ball now has a particle “spark” effect each time it hits a surface. 
- Clouds have been darkened slightly to make the golf ball and puttlers more visible.
- Ultra wide monitors, greater than 9:21 aspect ratio, now have black bars on the sides to hide ugly background stuff you guys really shouldn’t see.

UI:
- Added text to the bottom of the leaderboards to make earning course payout more clear.
- Video settings text for window mode changed to “Borderless Fullscreen” and “Exclusive Fullscreen”.
- Rotation keybinds moved to the top of controls underneath the lift and drop keybinds to make them more visible.
- Left Mouse Button keybind to drop text now displays in controls.
- Mouse scroll wheel keybind for rotation now displays in controls.

Misc:
- Gameplay keybinds are now disabled in the options to prevent players from accidentally using them while changing keybinds.  
- Removed the 30 fps option from the video settings, minimum is now 60 fps. If you’re negatively affected by this, please buy yourself a new monitor.🙏

We continue to strive to make Puttler the best experience it can be, so if you have any suggestions or features that were not included in this update, make sure to reach out to us and let us know!

Discord

notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Anderson here!

We discovered a rare bug on release which caused players to be unable to use inputs. We found that secondary inputs, such as touchscreen monitors, or controllers, would take priority causing keyboard and mouse inputs to no longer work making the game unplayable. It took a few updates, but I can now say that this bug has been completely fixed for all players. Please make sure to restart your system and update the game if you had this issue before, and thank you to all the individuals who reported the bug and shared information with us to help detect the problem.

Other various bugs and fixes:
- Fixed levels where the golf ball would bounce inconsistently in specific locations.
- Course info boxes with "Prize $200" are now consistent with other courses, "$200 Prize".
- Secret level "Next" button now says "Home" on completing, taking the player back to the menu.
- Cheat code "cat" pop-up would be off screen for some people, which has now been fixed.

Please email me directly for all bugs and issues at support@beanjuicestudios.com.
